text:
maria_finance: Quick flag — the March invoice batch completed but I'm seeing ~120 customers with missing 'compute' line items and 3 partner accounts got duplicate invoices. Not production panic yet but we need triage.

adam_billing: Ugh. Any common denominator? same plan / reserved vs on-demand?

maria_finance: Mostly on-demand hourly usage. Sample:
```
cust_id,invoice_id,line_type,amount
C-81234,INV-2026-03-701,compute,
C-81235,INV-2026-03-702,compute,0
C-99990,INV-2026-03-999,reserved,120.00
```

sara_engineering: Can you paste the job id for the batch? I'll check the ingestion + mapper pipeline.

maria_finance: batch_job=job_2026_03_25_04:12:07 (run by billing-bot). I already pulled one of the raw usage files — the hourly CSV looks complete. The mapper output shows missing compute for those cust IDs.

adam_billing: billing-bot logs? any errors during transform step?

billing-bot: Transform step finished with exit 0. Warnings: 3 duplicate invoice IDs detected and 0 error-level exceptions. Details stored at /var/logs/billing/2026-03/job_2026_03_25_04:12:07.log

lily_revops: If duplicates are real we need immediate stop on pdf generation and hold autopay. Can we block sends while we triage?

adam_billing: I'll pause pdf-export for the affected tenant list. Vincent, can support hold autopay on those account IDs?

vincent_support: Yep — share the list and I'll flip them to manual billing. Also will message affected customers if it looks like duplicates circulated.

sara_engineering: I'm seeing a pattern: the mapper uses a join between usage_events and pricing_profiles keyed by account_id. For those 120 accounts the join returned no rows because pricing_profile_id was NULL in the account metadata table. The usage import still created per-hour records but price lookup failed and downstream mapper emits empty compute line.

maria_finance: Why would pricing_profile_id be NULL? That table hasn't been modified this week. Any recent schema change?

sara_engineering: No schema change. However I see a backfill job that ran two days ago which re-wrote account metadata for a range of account_ids with a bug — it set pricing_profile_id to empty string for some shards.

adam_billing: That backfill was launched by ops_todo. Who approved it? We need rollback and a patch script to repopulate pricing_profile_id from the snapshot.

maria_finance: For duplicates — looks like 3 partner accounts had invoice generation retried by the job due to a flaky response from the pdf service; the retry logic created new invoice IDs instead of deduping on the original request id.

sara_engineering: I'll push a hotfix to mapper: 1) treat empty pricing_profile_id same as missing -> fail early, 2) emit error to dead-letter queue so batch fails fast. Also add idempotency check to invoice generator to dedupe by request_uuid.

lily_revops: Timeline? We need a remediation plan and a rollback window for revenue ops to run a re-generate safely.

sara_engineering: Patch ready in ~90 minutes. After that we can re-run the mapper for affected shards only. Need DB restore snapshot access to repopulate pricing_profile_id for ~120 accounts — should be quick (few minutes) if we run targeted update from snapshot table.

adam_billing: I'll prepare the account list and pause any downstream hooks. Maria, can you confirm the customer list and priority (who to notify first)?

maria_finance: I'll export list in 10. High priority: partners with duplicate invoices (send hold notice) + customers with high monthly spend (> $10k).

vincent_support: Once we have final invalid invoice IDs, I'll void them and issue corrected invoices. I'll also prep a customer-facing note for partners.

maria_finance: Thanks everyone. Action items: Sara (hotfix + rerun mapper), Adam (pause pdf/export + prepare list), Vincent (hold autopay + communications), Lily (coordinate finance ops reissue). I'll post the exported list here when ready. :thumbsup:

adam_billing: Copy — pausing pdf-export now.

sara_engineering: Hotfix deployed to staging. Running mapper on shard 7 now. Will report back with counts.

billing-bot: /job update job_2026_03_25_04:12:07 status=triage assigned=sara_engineering

maria_finance: Updated list attached: 120 affected accounts, 3 duplicates. Re-run scheduled for 11:30 UTC.
